O2_PER_CREW_DAY_KG.label: Oxygen per astronaut per day
O2_PER_CREW_DAY_KG.gameNote: Nominal metabolic oxygen use. We ignore activity changes except for EVAs.
O2_PER_CREW_DAY_KG.kidText: Each astronaut breathes about 0.82 kg of oxygen every day.

WATER_DRINK_FOOD_PER_CREW_DAY_KG.label: Drinking and food-prep water per astronaut
WATER_DRINK_FOOD_PER_CREW_DAY_KG.gameNote: Part of the 4.0 kg daily water total used in the game.
WATER_DRINK_FOOD_PER_CREW_DAY_KG.kidText: Each astronaut drinks or cooks with about 2.5 kg of water a day.

KCAL_PER_CREW_DAY.label: Food energy per astronaut per day
KCAL_PER_CREW_DAY.gameNote: BVAD gives a range of about 2,700 to 3,000 kcal. We use one middle value.
KCAL_PER_CREW_DAY.kidText: An astronaut needs about 2,800 kilocalories of food energy each day.

MARS_SOL_HOURS.label: Length of a Martian day (sol)
MARS_SOL_HOURS.gameNote: One game turn on Mars is one sol.
MARS_SOL_HOURS.kidText: A day on Mars is called a sol. It is about 40 minutes longer than a day on Earth.

SOLAR_CONSTANT_1AU.label: Sunlight power at Earth's distance (and the Moon's)
SOLAR_CONSTANT_1AU.gameNote: Used for the Moon's solar power, since the Moon has no atmosphere.
SOLAR_CONSTANT_1AU.kidText: Above the air, every square metre facing the Sun receives about 1,361 watts of sunlight.

MARS_TOA_IRRADIANCE_MEAN.label: Average sunlight at Mars (top of atmosphere)
MARS_TOA_IRRADIANCE_MEAN.gameNote: Derived: 1361 / 1.524² (Mars is 1.524 times farther from the Sun than Earth).
MARS_TOA_IRRADIANCE_MEAN.kidText: Mars is farther from the Sun, so its sunlight is less than half as strong as ours.

MARS_SURFACE_GCR_DOSE.label: Radiation dose on the surface of Mars
MARS_SURFACE_GCR_DOSE.gameNote: Measured by the RAD instrument on the Curiosity rover. Used as the daily background dose.
MARS_SURFACE_GCR_DOSE.kidText: Curiosity measured about 0.64 millisieverts of radiation per day on Mars.

MOON_SURFACE_DOSE.label: Radiation dose on the surface of the Moon
MOON_SURFACE_DOSE.gameNote: Measured by the Chang'e-4 lander. The Moon has no air or magnetic field to block radiation.
MOON_SURFACE_DOSE.kidText: The Moon's surface gets about twice the radiation of Mars because it has no air.

NASA_CAREER_LIMIT.label: NASA career radiation limit
NASA_CAREER_LIMIT.gameNote: Our mission budgets (45 and 75 mSv) are far below this real career limit.
NASA_CAREER_LIMIT.kidText: NASA allows an astronaut a total of 600 millisieverts over their whole career.

ISS_WATER_RECOVERY_MAX.label: Best water recovery on the ISS
ISS_WATER_RECOVERY_MAX.gameNote: Our level 3 recycler matches this value.
ISS_WATER_RECOVERY_MAX.kidText: The Space Station recycles about 98 out of every 100 kg of water.

O2_ELECTROLYSIS_MIN_ENERGY.label: Minimum energy to make oxygen from water
O2_ELECTROLYSIS_MIN_ENERGY.gameNote: 2 H₂O → 2 H₂ + O₂ needs about 571.6 kJ per 32 g of O₂, which is 17.9 MJ/kg or about 5.0 kWh/kg.
O2_ELECTROLYSIS_MIN_ENERGY.kidText: Splitting water into oxygen takes at least 5 kWh of electricity for every kilogram of oxygen.

OPPORTUNITY_STORM_TAU.label: Dust optical depth in the 2018 global storm
OPPORTUNITY_STORM_TAU.gameNote: Our global dust storm uses τ between 5 and 8, which already hits our power floor.
OPPORTUNITY_STORM_TAU.kidText: In 2018 a dust storm made the sky so dark that the Opportunity rover lost power forever.

LUNAR_SP_ILLUMINATION_MAX.label: Sunlit fraction at the best lunar south-pole ridges
LUNAR_SP_ILLUMINATION_MAX.gameNote: Published range is about 0.8 to 0.9. Our base starts with 0.8.
LUNAR_SP_ILLUMINATION_MAX.kidText: Some ridges near the Moon's south pole are in sunlight more than 80% of the time.

CREW_SIZE.label: Crew size
CREW_SIZE.kidText: You command a crew of five.

MISSION_DAYS.label: Mission length
MISSION_DAYS.gameNote: Set by the challenge framing. Demo mission is 7 days.
MISSION_DAYS.kidText: Keep your crew safe for 30 days.

O2_ENERGY_PER_KG.label: Energy used by our oxygen generator
O2_ENERGY_PER_KG.gameNote: Minimum 5.0 kWh/kg divided by about 70% machine efficiency.
O2_ENERGY_PER_KG.kidText: Real machines waste some energy, so our oxygen maker uses 7 kWh per kilogram.

O2_GEN_CAPACITY.label: Oxygen generator capacity
O2_GEN_CAPACITY.gameNote: Slightly above the crew's need of 4.1 kg/day.
O2_GEN_CAPACITY.kidText: The oxygen maker can produce up to 5 kg a day — just a little more than the crew breathes.

O2_TANK_MAX.label: Oxygen tank size
O2_TANK_MAX.gameNote: About 14 days of breathing for 5 astronauts.
O2_TANK_MAX.kidText: The oxygen tanks hold up to 60 kg, about two weeks of air.

O2_EVA_EXTRA_KG.label: Extra oxygen per astronaut on a spacewalk
O2_EVA_EXTRA_KG.gameNote: Hard work outside uses more oxygen.
O2_EVA_EXTRA_KG.kidText: Working outside in a spacesuit makes astronauts breathe harder.

LIFE_SUPPORT_BASE.label: Life support base power
LIFE_SUPPORT_BASE.kidText: Fans and air cleaners need power all day, even before making oxygen.

EVA_SUIT_ENERGY.label: Spacesuit recharge energy
EVA_SUIT_ENERGY.gameNote: Added to life support demand on EVA days.
EVA_SUIT_ENERGY.kidText: Spacesuit batteries must be recharged after every spacewalk.

DRILL_ENERGY.label: Drill power per drilling EVA
DRILL_ENERGY.gameNote: Two drilling EVAs use 10 kWh in total.
DRILL_ENERGY.kidText: Drilling into the ground for ice or samples takes extra power.

THERMAL_DEMAND_MARS.label: Heating power (Mars)
THERMAL_DEMAND_MARS.kidText: Mars nights are freezing, so the base needs heating.

THERMAL_DEMAND_MOON.label: Heating power (Moon)
THERMAL_DEMAND_MOON.gameNote: The lunar pole is colder, so heating costs more.
THERMAL_DEMAND_MOON.kidText: Near the Moon's south pole it is even colder, so heating needs more power.

WATER_TOTAL_PER_CREW_DAY.label: Total water use per astronaut
WATER_TOTAL_PER_CREW_DAY.gameNote: Drinking and food 2.5 kg plus hygiene 1.5 kg (simplified).
WATER_TOTAL_PER_CREW_DAY.kidText: Each astronaut uses about 4 kg of water a day for drinking, cooking and washing.

WATER_PROCESS_ENERGY.label: Water recycler energy
WATER_PROCESS_ENERGY.gameNote: Simplified energy per kg of wastewater.

RECYCLER_CAPACITY_KG_DAY.label: Water recycler processing capacity
RECYCLER_CAPACITY_KG_DAY.gameNote: Twice the crew's daily use, so a backlog can be caught up after a power cut.
RECYCLER_CAPACITY_KG_DAY.kidText: The recycler can clean up to 40 kg of used water a day, so it can catch up after a storm.

WASTEWATER_TANK_MAX.label: Wastewater holding tank
WASTEWATER_TANK_MAX.gameNote: Used water waits here when the recycler has no power. Overflow is lost.
WASTEWATER_TANK_MAX.kidText: Used water is stored in a tank until the recycler has power to clean it.

RECYCLER_RATE_BY_LEVEL.label: Water recovered by recycler level
RECYCLER_RATE_BY_LEVEL.gameNote: Trend toward the ISS value of 98%.
RECYCLER_RATE_BY_LEVEL.kidText: Better recyclers save more water. The best one recovers 98%.

GH_AREA_PER_LEVEL.label: Greenhouse growing area per level
GH_AREA_PER_LEVEL.gameNote: Each greenhouse level adds one 10 m² growing bed.
GH_AREA_PER_LEVEL.kidText: Each greenhouse upgrade adds 10 square metres of plants.

GH_LIGHT_ENERGY_PER_M2.label: Greenhouse lighting energy
GH_LIGHT_ENERGY_PER_M2.kidText: Plants indoors need bright lamps, and lamps need power.

GH_YIELD_PER_M2.label: Greenhouse food yield
GH_YIELD_PER_M2.kidText: One square metre of grown plants gives about 120 kcal of food a day.

GH_NET_WATER_PER_M2.label: Greenhouse water use
GH_NET_WATER_PER_M2.gameNote: Net loss only: a closed greenhouse condenses and reuses most of the water plants transpire. Balanced from 0.3 so a full greenhouse does not outweigh the crew's own water use.
GH_NET_WATER_PER_M2.kidText: Plants drink water too, although most of it is recycled.

GH_MATURITY_DAYS.label: Days for crops to mature
GH_MATURITY_DAYS.gameNote: Fast crops such as lettuce and radish (simplified).
GH_MATURITY_DAYS.kidText: Fast-growing plants like lettuce are ready in about 10 days in our game.

START_GH_MATURITY.label: Starting crop maturity
START_GH_MATURITY.gameNote: The first bed was planted before the mission starts.
START_GH_MATURITY.kidText: Your first plants are already half grown when you arrive.

BOTANIST_YIELD_BONUS.label: Botanist greenhouse bonus
BOTANIST_YIELD_BONUS.gameNote: Applies when the Botanist works in the greenhouse.
BOTANIST_YIELD_BONUS.kidText: A plant expert in the greenhouse grows 10% more food.

LAB_DEMAND.label: Science lab power
LAB_DEMAND.kidText: Experiments need power for instruments and computers.

LAB_SP_PER_DAY.label: Science points from the lab
LAB_SP_PER_DAY.gameNote: Needs at least one crew member on Research.
LAB_SP_PER_DAY.kidText: A powered lab with a researcher earns science points every day.

SCIENTIST_SP_BONUS.label: Scientist science bonus
SCIENTIST_SP_BONUS.gameNote: Applies to lab work and EVAs the Scientist joins.
SCIENTIST_SP_BONUS.kidText: Your Scientist earns 15% more science points.

EVA_SP.label: Science points per EVA
EVA_SP.gameNote: One EVA uses two crew members for one day.
EVA_SP.kidText: Every spacewalk brings back samples worth science points.

EVA_MAX_TAU.label: Dust limit for EVAs
EVA_MAX_TAU.gameNote: EVAs are blocked when the sky is too dusty.
EVA_MAX_TAU.kidText: It is not safe to walk outside in a thick dust storm.

EVA_MIN_HEALTH.label: Minimum health for EVAs
EVA_MIN_HEALTH.gameNote: Crew below this health cannot go outside.
EVA_MIN_HEALTH.kidText: Only healthy astronauts may go on spacewalks.

SOLAR_AREA_BASE_MARS.label: Starting solar panel area (Mars)
SOLAR_AREA_BASE_MARS.kidText: Your Mars base starts with 120 square metres of solar panels.

SOLAR_AREA_PER_LEVEL_MARS.label: Extra solar area per upgrade (Mars)
SOLAR_AREA_PER_LEVEL_MARS.kidText: Each solar upgrade adds 25 square metres of panels.

SOLAR_AREA_BASE_MOON.label: Starting solar panel area (Moon)
SOLAR_AREA_BASE_MOON.gameNote: Moon panels see stronger sunlight for longer.
SOLAR_AREA_BASE_MOON.kidText: On the Moon, sunlight is much stronger, so fewer panels are needed.

SOLAR_AREA_PER_LEVEL_MOON.label: Extra solar area per upgrade (Moon)
SOLAR_AREA_PER_LEVEL_MOON.kidText: Each solar upgrade on the Moon adds 6 square metres of panels.

PANEL_EFFICIENCY.label: Solar cell efficiency
PANEL_EFFICIENCY.gameNote: Modern space-grade cells reach about 28 to 30%.
PANEL_EFFICIENCY.kidText: Solar cells turn about 28% of sunlight into electricity.

SYSTEM_LOSSES.label: Electrical system efficiency
SYSTEM_LOSSES.kidText: Some electricity is lost as heat in wires and converters.

MARS_CLEAR_INSOLATION.label: Daily sunlight on a clear Martian day
MARS_CLEAR_INSOLATION.gameNote: Equatorial clear-sky approximation, still to verify against Mars weather data.
MARS_CLEAR_INSOLATION.kidText: On a clear day, each square metre on Mars gets about 3 kWh of sunlight.

MARS_CLEAR_TAU.label: Normal dust level of the Martian sky
MARS_CLEAR_TAU.kidText: Even a clear Martian sky has a little dust in it.

MARS_TAU_DAILY_VARIATION.label: Daily change in sky dust
MARS_TAU_DAILY_VARIATION.gameNote: Clear days vary between τ 0.5 and 0.8.
MARS_TAU_DAILY_VARIATION.kidText: The amount of dust in the sky changes a little every day.

DUST_SKY_COEFF.label: Dust dimming factor
DUST_SKY_COEFF.gameNote: Fit: sunlight = exp(−0.4 × (τ − 0.5)), equal to 1.0 on a clear day.
DUST_SKY_COEFF.kidText: The dustier the sky, the less sunlight reaches the panels.

DUST_SKY_FLOOR.label: Minimum sunlight in a global storm
DUST_SKY_FLOOR.kidText: Even in the worst storm, a little light still gets through.

DUST_ACCUM_PER_SOL.label: Dust settling on panels
DUST_ACCUM_PER_SOL.gameNote: About 0.2% output loss per sol, similar to rover trends.
DUST_ACCUM_PER_SOL.kidText: Dust slowly settles on the panels and makes them weaker.

DUST_STORM_DEPOSIT_PER_SOL.label: Extra dust on panels during storms
DUST_STORM_DEPOSIT_PER_SOL.gameNote: Storms drop dust five times faster.
DUST_STORM_DEPOSIT_PER_SOL.kidText: Dust storms cover the panels much faster.

CLEANING_BOT_INTERVAL.label: Cleaning robot schedule
CLEANING_BOT_INTERVAL.gameNote: The robot cleans the panels every 5 sols.
CLEANING_BOT_INTERVAL.kidText: A cleaning robot brushes the panels every 5 sols.

MOON_GEOMETRY_FACTOR.label: Low sun angle at the lunar pole
MOON_GEOMETRY_FACTOR.gameNote: Tracking panels with a low Sun on the horizon.
MOON_GEOMETRY_FACTOR.kidText: At the Moon's pole the Sun stays low in the sky.

MOON_BASE_ILLUMINATION.label: Normal sunlit fraction of the day (Moon)
MOON_BASE_ILLUMINATION.gameNote: Based on the best polar ridges.
MOON_BASE_ILLUMINATION.kidText: Your Moon base is in sunlight 80% of the time.

HOURS_PER_DAY.label: Hours in a game day (Moon)
HOURS_PER_DAY.kidText: On the Moon, one turn is one Earth day of 24 hours.

BATTERY_BASE.label: Starting battery size
BATTERY_BASE.kidText: Your battery stores 60 kWh to use at night.

BATTERY_PER_LEVEL.label: Extra battery per upgrade
BATTERY_PER_LEVEL.kidText: Each battery upgrade stores 40 kWh more.

BATTERY_EFF_IN.label: Battery charging efficiency
BATTERY_EFF_IN.gameNote: About 90% round trip together with discharge.
BATTERY_EFF_IN.kidText: A little energy is lost when charging a battery.

BATTERY_EFF_OUT.label: Battery discharging efficiency
BATTERY_EFF_OUT.gameNote: About 90% round trip together with charging.
BATTERY_EFF_OUT.kidText: A little energy is lost when using a battery too.

MARS_NIGHT_FRACTION.label: Share of the day without sunlight (Mars)
MARS_NIGHT_FRACTION.gameNote: Half of the daily load must come from the battery.
MARS_NIGHT_FRACTION.kidText: Half of every sol is night, so the base runs on its battery.

SHIELD_GCR_REDUCTION.label: Background radiation blocked by shielding
SHIELD_GCR_REDUCTION.gameNote: Cosmic rays are hard to block, so each level helps less.
SHIELD_GCR_REDUCTION.kidText: Piling soil on the base blocks some cosmic rays, but never all of them.

SHIELD_SPE_REDUCTION.label: Solar storm radiation blocked by shielding
SHIELD_SPE_REDUCTION.gameNote: Solar protons are easier to stop than cosmic rays.
SHIELD_SPE_REDUCTION.kidText: Shielding works better against solar storms than against cosmic rays.

SHELTER_SPE_REDUCTION.label: Storm shelter protection
SHELTER_SPE_REDUCTION.gameNote: A small room surrounded by water tanks.
SHELTER_SPE_REDUCTION.kidText: Hiding in the storm shelter blocks 90% of a solar storm's radiation.

SPE_DOSE_UNSHIELDED_MARS.label: Solar storm dose (Mars)
SPE_DOSE_UNSHIELDED_MARS.gameNote: The Martian atmosphere gives partial protection.
SPE_DOSE_UNSHIELDED_MARS.kidText: On Mars, the thin air blocks part of a solar storm.

SPE_DOSE_UNSHIELDED_MOON.label: Solar storm dose (Moon)
SPE_DOSE_UNSHIELDED_MOON.kidText: On the Moon nothing blocks a solar storm, so shelters are vital.

MISSION_DOSE_BUDGET_MARS.label: Mission radiation budget (Mars)
MISSION_DOSE_BUDGET_MARS.gameNote: Game budget, far below the 600 mSv career limit.
MISSION_DOSE_BUDGET_MARS.kidText: Keep each astronaut's average dose under 45 mSv on Mars.

MISSION_DOSE_BUDGET_MOON.label: Mission radiation budget (Moon)
MISSION_DOSE_BUDGET_MOON.gameNote: Game budget, far below the 600 mSv career limit.
MISSION_DOSE_BUDGET_MOON.kidText: Keep each astronaut's average dose under 75 mSv on the Moon.

SPE_HEALTH_DOSE_THRESHOLD.label: Daily dose that harms health
SPE_HEALTH_DOSE_THRESHOLD.gameNote: Real radiation sickness needs hundreds of mSv at once. This penalty is a game simplification to show that solar storms are dangerous and that shelters work.
SPE_HEALTH_DOSE_THRESHOLD.kidText: In the game, a big solar storm dose makes astronauts feel unwell.

BP_INCOME_BASE.label: Daily build points
BP_INCOME_BASE.kidText: The base makes 4 build points every day.

BP_PER_REGOLITH_CREW.label: Build points per regolith worker
BP_PER_REGOLITH_CREW.gameNote: Regolith is the loose rock and dust on the surface.
BP_PER_REGOLITH_CREW.kidText: Each astronaut processing soil adds 3 build points a day.

START_O2_KG.label: Starting oxygen
START_O2_KG.kidText: You start with 40 kg of oxygen in the tanks.

START_WATER_MARS.label: Starting water (Mars)
START_WATER_MARS.kidText: Your Mars base starts with 300 kg of water.

START_WATER_MOON.label: Starting water (Moon)
START_WATER_MOON.gameNote: Less water is carried to the Moon because polar ice can be mined.
START_WATER_MOON.kidText: Your Moon base starts with 250 kg of water, but there is ice nearby.

START_FOOD_KCAL.label: Starting food
START_FOOD_KCAL.gameNote: 80% of the crew's 30-day need. The greenhouse must make up the rest.
START_FOOD_KCAL.kidText: You brought 80% of the food you need. Your greenhouse has to grow the rest.

START_BP.label: Starting build points
START_BP.kidText: You start with 40 build points for upgrades.

DIFFICULTY_RESERVE_MULTIPLIER.label: Starting supplies by difficulty
DIFFICULTY_RESERVE_MULTIPLIER.gameNote: Applied to starting oxygen, water and food. Build points are the same on every difficulty.
DIFFICULTY_RESERVE_MULTIPLIER.kidText: Training gives you extra supplies. Commander gives you less.

EVENT_FREQUENCY_MULTIPLIER.label: Event frequency by difficulty
EVENT_FREQUENCY_MULTIPLIER.gameNote: Multiplies the daily chance of every random event.

HEALTH_O2_PENALTY.label: Health lost without enough air
HEALTH_O2_PENALTY.kidText: Without enough air, astronauts quickly become unwell.

HEALTH_WATER_PENALTY.label: Health lost without enough water
HEALTH_WATER_PENALTY.kidText: Not drinking enough water makes astronauts weak.

HEALTH_FOOD_SEVERE_PENALTY.label: Health lost with less than half rations
HEALTH_FOOD_SEVERE_PENALTY.gameNote: Applies when less than half the food need is eaten.
HEALTH_FOOD_SEVERE_PENALTY.kidText: Eating less than half the food you need is very bad for health.

HEALTH_FOOD_MILD_PENALTY.label: Health lost with reduced rations
HEALTH_FOOD_MILD_PENALTY.gameNote: Applies when some food is missing.

HEALTH_THERMAL_PENALTY.label: Health lost when heating is cut
HEALTH_THERMAL_PENALTY.gameNote: Scaled by how much heating was missing.
HEALTH_THERMAL_PENALTY.kidText: A cold base makes the crew unwell.

HEALTH_SPE_PENALTY.label: Health lost after a big solar storm dose
HEALTH_SPE_PENALTY.gameNote: Game simplification; see the daily dose that harms health.
HEALTH_SPE_PENALTY.kidText: A big dose from a solar storm makes astronauts feel ill.

HEALTH_RECOVERY.label: Daily recovery when all needs are met
HEALTH_RECOVERY.gameNote: Plus bonuses from the Medic and rest.
HEALTH_RECOVERY.kidText: Well-fed, rested astronauts slowly get healthier.

MEDIC_RECOVERY_BONUS.label: Medic recovery bonus
MEDIC_RECOVERY_BONUS.kidText: The Medic helps everyone recover faster.

REST_RECOVERY_BONUS.label: Rest recovery bonus
REST_RECOVERY_BONUS.kidText: A day of rest helps an astronaut recover.

FOOD_SEVERE_RATION.label: Severe food shortage level
FOOD_SEVERE_RATION.gameNote: Three days below this ends the mission.
FOOD_SEVERE_RATION.kidText: If the crew eats less than half their food for 3 days, the mission ends.

FOOD_FAIL_STREAK.label: Days of severe food shortage allowed
FOOD_FAIL_STREAK.kidText: The crew can survive only a few days of very low food.

REPAIR_COST_BP.label: Repair cost
REPAIR_COST_BP.kidText: Fixing broken equipment uses spare parts.

REPAIR_DAYS_ENGINEER.label: Repair time with the Engineer
REPAIR_DAYS_ENGINEER.kidText: Your Engineer can fix things in 1 day.

REPAIR_SUCCESS_BASE.label: Repair success chance
REPAIR_SUCCESS_BASE.gameNote: A failed attempt adds one more day.
REPAIR_SUCCESS_BASE.kidText: Most repairs work the first time, but not always.

COMMANDER_REPAIR_BONUS.label: Commander repair bonus
COMMANDER_REPAIR_BONUS.kidText: A good commander makes repairs go more smoothly.

ICE_WATER_KG.label: Water from lunar ice prospecting
ICE_WATER_KG.gameNote: Reward for completing the Moon drilling objective.
ICE_WATER_KG.kidText: Ice at the Moon's poles can be melted into drinking water.

MAX_EVACUATIONS.label: Evacuations allowed
MAX_EVACUATIONS.gameNote: Three or more evacuations end the mission.
MAX_EVACUATIONS.kidText: If 3 astronauts must be sent home, the mission ends.

ALERT_AMBER_DAYS.label: Warning alert threshold
ALERT_AMBER_DAYS.gameNote: A resource lasting fewer days shows a warning.
ALERT_AMBER_DAYS.kidText: You get a warning when something will run out within a week.

ALERT_RED_DAYS.label: Critical alert threshold
ALERT_RED_DAYS.gameNote: A resource lasting fewer days is critical.
ALERT_RED_DAYS.kidText: Critical alerts mean something runs out in less than 3 days.

BATTERY_LOW_FRACTION.label: Low battery alert
BATTERY_LOW_FRACTION.gameNote: Battery below 10% at the end of the day.
BATTERY_LOW_FRACTION.kidText: An almost empty battery at sunrise means the night was too long for it.

BATTERY_WASTE_KWH.label: Wasted solar energy alert
BATTERY_WASTE_KWH.gameNote: Energy that could not be stored because the battery was full.
BATTERY_WASTE_KWH.kidText: If the battery is full, extra sunshine is wasted.

HEALTH_AMBER.label: Low health warning
HEALTH_AMBER.kidText: A warning appears if someone's health falls below 50.

HEALTH_RED.label: Critical health alert
HEALTH_RED.kidText: Below 30 health, an astronaut is in danger.

DOSE_AMBER_FRACTION.label: Radiation warning
DOSE_AMBER_FRACTION.gameNote: Average dose above 60% of the mission budget.
DOSE_AMBER_FRACTION.kidText: A warning appears when the crew has used 60% of its radiation budget.

DOSE_RED_FRACTION.label: Radiation critical alert
DOSE_RED_FRACTION.gameNote: Average dose above 80% of the mission budget.
DOSE_RED_FRACTION.kidText: At 80% of the radiation budget, the crew must be protected.

MODULE_DOWN_CONDITION.label: Broken equipment alert
MODULE_DOWN_CONDITION.kidText: Equipment working at less than half strength needs a repair.

SCORE_PER_DAY.label: Score per day survived
SCORE_PER_DAY.kidText: Every day you survive earns 10 points.

SCORE_EVAC_PENALTY.label: Score lost per evacuation
SCORE_EVAC_PENALTY.kidText: Sending an astronaut home costs 50 points.

SCORE_LS_SHED_PENALTY.label: Score lost per day life support was cut
SCORE_LS_SHED_PENALTY.kidText: Each day life support does not get full power costs 15 points.
